verses.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ אֹודְךָ֥ בְכָל־לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ أَحْمَدُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ قَلْبِي. قُدَّامَ ٱلْآلِهَةِ أُرَنِّمُ لَكَ.
verses.en: A Psalm of David. I will give Thee thanks with my whole heart, in the presence of the mighty will I sing praises unto Thee.
verses.kjv: [A Psalm] of David. I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.web: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

verses.he: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁךָ֡ וְאֹ֘ודֶ֤ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: أَسْجُدُ فِي هَيْكَلِ قُدْسِكَ، وَأَحْمَدُ ٱسْمَكَ عَلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَحَقِّكَ، لِأَنَّكَ قَدْ عَظَّمْتَ كَلِمَتَكَ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱسْمِكَ.
verses.en: I will bow down toward Thy holy temple, and give thanks unto Thy name for Thy mercy and for Thy truth; for Thou hast magnified Thy word above all Thy name.
verses.kjv: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.web: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

verses.he: בְּיֹ֣ום קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃
verses.ar: فِي يَوْمَ دَعَوْتُكَ أَجَبْتَنِي. شَجَّعْتَنِي قُوَّةً فِي نَفْسِي.
verses.en: In the day that I called, Thou didst answer me; Thou didst encourage me in my soul with strength.
verses.kjv: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, [and] strengthenedst me [with] strength in my soul.
verses.web: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

verses.he: יֹוד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: يَحْمَدُكَ يَارَبُّ كُلُّ مُلُوكِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، إِذَا سَمِعُوا كَلِمَاتِ فَمِكَ.
verses.en: All the kings of the earth shall give Thee thanks, O LORD, for they have heard the words of Thy mouth.
verses.kjv: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.web: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

verses.he: וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י גָ֝דֹ֗ול כְּבֹ֣וד יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَيُرَنِّمُونَ فِي طُرُقِ ٱلرَّبِّ، لِأَنَّ مَجْدَ ٱلرَّبِّ عَظِيمٌ.
verses.en: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of the LORD; for great is the glory of the LORD.
verses.kjv: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great [is] the glory of the LORD.
verses.web: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!

verses.he: כִּי־רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ عَالٍ وَيَرَى ٱلْمُتَوَاضِعَ، أَمَّا ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ فَيَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ بَعِيدٍ.
verses.en: For though the LORD be high, yet regardeth He the lowly, and the haughty He knoweth from afar.
verses.kjv: Though the LORD [be] high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.web: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

verses.he: אִם־אֵלֵ֤ךְ ׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֖יְבַי תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְתֹ֖ושִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: إِنْ سَلَكْتُ فِي وَسَطِ ٱلضِّيْقِ تُحْيِنِي. عَلَى غَضَبِ أَعْدَائِي تَمُدُّ يَدَكَ، وَتُخَلِّصُنِي يَمِينُكَ.
verses.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, Thou quickenest me; Thou stretchest forth Thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and Thy right hand doth save me.
verses.kjv: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.web: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

verses.he: יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעֹולָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּֽרֶף׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يُحَامِي عَنِّي. يَارَبُّ، رَحْمَتُكَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. عَنْ أَعْمَالِ يَدَيْكَ لَا تَتَخَلَّ.
verses.en: The LORD will accomplish that which concerneth me; Thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever; forsake not the work of Thine own hands.
verses.kjv: The LORD will perfect [that which] concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, [endureth] for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.web: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
